description: Cursor-paginated bulk snapshot of endpoints or resources. PRICED: $0.25 in USDC on base via x402 -- no account, no API key, no invoice. Call without `payment` to receive the exact payment requirements, then call again with `payment` to be served. Returns a 1000-record page. Price is per page, not per record. Pass the returned cursor to continue.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

payment.description: Optional. An x402 X-PAYMENT header value. Omit it to receive the payment requirements for this call; supply it to be served. Price: $0.25

name: bulk_export
